summary: Lotus Technology Inc., a Shanghai-domiciled manufacturer of sports and luxury EVs listed on Nasdaq, furnished a Form 6-K with the SEC covering the period ended June 30, 2026. The submission contains 127 documents of routine periodic disclosure, including interim financial statements, XBRL tagging, related-party service and lease disclosures, equity-incentive and employee stock option data, and an exchangeable-notes measurement period. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation, advisor, or structural event is described. No US-equivalent special-situation event is present; the filing is an ordinary foreign-private-issuer report. For risk arbitrage, there is no deal to track and no actionable catalyst.
